name: impact_com-mcp
description: impact.com (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_impact_com_account_sid.title: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_ACCOUNT_SID
platform_mcp_impact_com_account_sid.description: Account SID of a Brand API access token (impact.com > user profile > Settings > Technical > API > Create Access Token); the HTTP Basic username and the {AccountSID} in every path.

platform_mcp_impact_com_auth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_AUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_impact_com_auth_token.description: The token's Auth Token, the HTTP Basic password. Needs read scope for programs and reports.

platform_mcp_impact_com_report_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_IMPACT_COM_REPORT_ID
platform_mcp_impact_com_report_id.description: Report handle for get_report, taken from GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Reports (Id of a report with ApiAccessible=true, e.g. a performance-by-day report); its columns are listed by /Reports/{ReportId}/MetaData.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/CompanyInformation: the brand account's company details.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Campaigns: the account's programs (impact.com calls programs 'Campaigns'); status filters State (ACTIVE, AWAITING_REVIEW, CANCELLED, CLOSED, DEACTIVATED, DELINQUENT, REJECTED, SETUP, SETUP_COMPLETE). Programs carry no budget; Type (Performance, Retail Media, Creator …) is in raw. `account_id` is not sent (the Account SID selects the account); `page`/`limit` are not sent (only the first page is returned).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Reports/{report_id}?StartDate&EndDate&SUBAID=<campaign_id> (Run a Report, synchronous legacy endpoint with pagination limits): the configured report's Records, with the report's own columns (see /Reports/{report_id}/MetaData) left as returned in each row's raw. campaign_id is the program id (SUBAID), 'required for most reports'. Needs the report_id config field. `account_id` is not sent.
